quotes.text: What a delight. The flight form Phoenix to the Grand Canyon via Sedona was fascinating. Having spent a few days at south rim it was great to get a different perspective. Then on the the marvels of Monument Valley - Hard to describe and do justice. A Navajo tac lunch and then a flight back rounded out a great day.

quotes.author: Kittiemae2
quotes.text: Westwind gave me everything I had hoped for...An overall informative/view of the Grand Canyon. We could never have visited the Canyon in one day like Westwind provided for us both on the ground and in the air. Excellent customer service too. Hope we can bring the rest of the family in the future.

quotes.author: kykarla
quotes.text: We took the West rim tour with the helicopter and boat rides. The whole experience, from booking to end of tour, was easy. The ladies in the office (Val and Gayle) are friendly and enthusiastic. Snacks and water were provided for our trip. Steven was our pilot and helped make the day perfect.

quotes.author: jhajha
quotes.text: This trip was everything we could have hoped for and more! The entire staff was professional, courteous, and most importantly very good at what they do! Our pilot flew us up, took us around to the various scheduled activities, and made everything go smoothly.

quotes.author: spacemum
quotes.text: We did the Grand canyon to monument valley with ground tour trip. Very good, scenic flight over the Grand canyon was breathtaking, trip in MV was OK, saw all the main sights, would definitely recommend as a treat.

quotes.author: rafaelf991
quotes.text: Pilot and Co pilot were very professional. Seeing Sedona from up and afterwards the Grand Canyon was amazing and I deeply think that it is one of a lifetime experience not to be missed.
